dedupe_keys.name: monitored hygrothermal dataset of a high altitude dolomite refuge wall and indoor climate at 2870 m a s l

description: Monitored hygrothermal dataset of a high-altitude Dolomite refuge: wall and indoor climate at 2870 m a.s.l. is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Simone Panico et al. A five-year hygrothermal dataset (23 September 2020 to 8 August 2025) was compiled from Rifugio Boé, a 1905 stone mountain refuge situated at 2870 m a.s.l. in the Dolomites. Coverage: global; published in 2026. Formats: CSV. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
